acceptance_criteria.statement: Pre-acquisition authorization fails closed; temporary execution denial preserves exact approved provenance, while material capability/binding/policy/reference mismatch durably stales and invalidates old approval.
Logical execution identity and canonical-json-v1 fingerprint are server-owned, caller-noninfluenceable, immutable and acquired atomically by exactly one contender.
Admission reloads current Workspace/resource/execution authority, compatibility and complete m4r1 integrity/trust/key state under the fixed epoch lock protocol.
Fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time commits one complete immutable DispatchAdmissionWitness; commit/ack ambiguity resolves to exact committed readback or complete rollback absence.
Admission is logical write start; later mutation or expiry cannot cancel, upgrade or retarget the original byte-identical envelope.
Independent SQLite provider atomically owns effects/closed outcomes and exact logical-ID/fingerprint idempotency, replay, conflict, cross-binding rejection and restart semantics.
Every post-admission uncertainty branch has exact provider state and remains Knora executing/indeterminate with unchanged identities and no #77 recovery authority.
Generation-1 observation/finalization uses fresh post-lock database time and expired owners cannot append observation/audit or terminal state.
Only named direct outcomes finalize; every application/HTTP result exactly matches a complete immutable sanitized result matrix.
Restarted append-only audit reconstructs complete provenance while SQLite remains independent and all private/secret fields are absent; M1-M3 regressions stay green.

design_decisions.decision: Keep WriteProposalWorkflow.handle as the sole deep application Interface; witnesses and protocol ordering remain private.
Commit durable PostgreSQL admission before provider I/O and classify post-admission uncertainty as receipt-possible.
Persist the exact canonical envelope bytes with retained verification material and never regenerate after admission.
Use a private non-runtime trusted signing harness for provider defensive conflict and cross-binding coverage; prove it is unresolved by every production application/HTTP DI surface.
Persist read-only NoAdmission or AdmissionOutstanding recovery seeds; all runtime reconciliation/retry/takeover remains #78.
Use fresh PostgreSQL clock_timestamp after blocking locks for execution decisions.

invariants: No gateway call exists without one durable admission; at most one admission exists per logical execution.
Every acquisition loser and every denied admission row makes zero provider calls.
Every admission linearizes current authority, exact compatibility and complete m4r1 verification under fixed epochs.
Admission-first dispatch remains byte-identical despite later mutation or expiry.
Provider effects and idempotency outcomes commit atomically in provider-owned SQLite.
Provider scope/cross-binding rejection occurs before target lookup and before SQLite ledger/effect mutation.
Provider outcome not-found and named terminal rejection are disjoint typed states.
Issue #77 creates and acts only on generation 1 with no reconciliation, retry, replay authorization or takeover.
The capability registry remains static and typed with no plugin framework.
Test-only trusted signers and mutators cannot be resolved or invoked from production application/HTTP composition.
Every post-acquisition or repeated-execute public result matches the immutable result matrix; every other field is forbidden.
Raw provider/routing, envelope/MAC, fingerprint, authority, key, credential and secret fields never enter public projections.
out_of_scope: ReconcileExecution, provider-first application recovery, stale takeover, generation 2+ and authorized replay, owned by #78.
Distributed rollback/cancellation or arbitrary remote-vendor time protocols.
Dynamic plugins, provider discovery or runtime registration.
Editing immutable proposals or reusing approval after material incompatibility.
Final M4 code review before Issues #75-#79 are accepted, integrated and closed.

test_cases.statement: Exercise all pre-acquisition denials, limited read/observation grants, temporary execution revocation and every material mismatch with durable before/after reload and old-approval retry.
test_cases.oracle: Denied branches create no execution/admission/provider call; temporary denial preserves approved provenance; each material mismatch persists typed stale/invalidated state and requires a new proposal/approval.

test_cases.statement: Reject caller identity injection, independently recompute canonical fingerprint across every boundary, race identified contenders and fault each acquisition write before commit/restart.
test_cases.oracle: Identities are server-owned and immutable; one complete AcquireApplied tuple commits, every loser has zero calls, pre-commit state is invisible and rollback leaves no fragment.

test_cases.statement: Block after acquisition; run separate Workspace/resource/execution authority, every capability/binding/policy selector, canonical-byte/MAC/claim, trusted-store and complete key-lifecycle rows plus one compatible control.
test_cases.oracle: Each row is compared with an independently sourced exact typed result. Every denial occurs after post-lock reload with zero admission/audit and zero gateway/provider calls; compatible active/retiring rows admit once; transitions obey epoch linearization.

test_cases.statement: Race real epoch mutations and same-generation issuers; block acquisition/admission across proposal/reference/lease expiry under skewed non-database clocks.
test_cases.oracle: Mutation-first denies, admission-first binds prior epochs, one admission exists and fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time decides every expiry.

test_cases.statement: Compare the complete admission tuple/bytes, restart and rotate current key, then force committed-before-ack and rolled-back PostgreSQL branches with authoritative readback.
test_cases.oracle: Committed state equals intended bytes with no second insert/sign/regeneration; rollback has complete absence, zero call/retry and no partial third state.

test_cases.statement: Pause after admission, mutate/revoke every authority/selector/key and cross every expiry before dispatch resumes.
test_cases.oracle: Exactly one call carries the original byte-identical envelope/intent without reauthorization, cancellation, upgrade or retargeting.

test_cases.statement: At the private SQLite provider harness, cover replay, valid unequal fingerprints, ordinary tampering, independently valid cross-binding, success, three closed rejections, pre-commit rollback and committed-before-ack restart.
test_cases.oracle: Cross-binding returns provider_scope_denied after integrity verification but before target lookup and any SQLite ledger/effect mutation with exact zero counters; other rows preserve atomic effect/outcome, conflict, tamper and restart semantics.

test_cases.statement: Run admission-before-gateway, pre-SQLite-commit and committed-before-ack as named branches with success/rejection variants and read-only provider observation.
test_cases.oracle: First two are exact zero/zero, committed is exact one durable outcome, and every unfinalized branch stays executing/indeterminate with unchanged identities and no #77 recovery authority.

test_cases.statement: Restart/reload NoAdmission and AdmissionOutstanding seeds and call ExecuteApprovedProposal again.
test_cases.oracle: Both return the immutable-matrix ExecutionInProgress result with no provider observation, admission creation/replacement, dispatch/replay, retry, takeover or generation increment.

test_cases.statement: Delay success and each rejection across lease expiry; cover before-expiry success/rejections, indeterminate, current in-progress, conflict and fenced results using an independently loaded immutable public-result matrix.
test_cases.oracle: Expired owners cannot change PostgreSQL state. Every outcome has exact outcome_type, lifecycle, HTTP status, common/variant keys and value domain; application and HTTP projections match field-for-field and reject every extra recursive field.

test_cases.statement: Restart PostgreSQL and SQLite independently, reconstruct audit solely from append-only rows, read provider truth separately and scan forbidden fields.
test_cases.oracle: Complete provenance matches field-for-field, provider ledger stays independent and no raw/private/secret value leaks.

test_cases.statement: Inventory every production application/HTTP DI surface; probe resolution and invocation of every test-only signer/mutator plus registration/discovery/plugin loading, then run focused/full pytest serially, Ruff, Compose and clean Alembic verification.
test_cases.oracle: No production surface resolves a test-only adapter or dynamic seam and all probes leave dependency, registry, PostgreSQL, SQLite, lookup, provider and effect state unchanged; all verification remains green.

command_projections.statement: Clean PostgreSQL recreation and Alembic upgrade/current using pinned Python and serialized database.
Locked focused Issue #77 pytest files followed by full test and eval pytest suites.
Ruff, Docker Compose config, subject SHA, evidence bundle and clean-worktree verification.

required_evidence.statement: Authorization/stale snapshots, identity injection rejection, canonical recomputation and complete contender-correlated acquisition evidence.
Independently sourced complete post-acquisition row/result matrix, compatible control, all epoch/m4r1 traces, per-row zero admission/audit/gateway/provider counters and fresh PostgreSQL time samples.
Complete admission witness, exact envelope, ambiguity branches and admission-first non-cancellation evidence.
Provider-owned effect/outcome/replay/conflict/tamper/cross-binding/rollback/restart evidence, including cross-binding verification order and zero target-lookup/ledger/effect counters.
Three exact crash-window records, provider-not-found distinction, two recovery seeds and absence of #78 behavior.

Fenced PostgreSQL snapshots, independent immutable public-result matrix and per-row HTTP/application comparisons, forbidden-field scans, complete production DI resolution/invocation isolation matrix, full audit reconstruction and governed verification identities/totals.

prior_findings.resolution: TC-03 retains the complete active/retiring/revoked/unknown/unavailable and rotation-transition key matrix with post-lock key identity/epoch and per-row counters.
TC-10 retains exact expired-owner observation/audit identity, count, digest and zero-write fencing evidence.
TC-12 retains production-composition closed-registry and structural no-registration/discovery/plugin probes.
TC-03 now assigns every authority/selector/integrity/trusted-store row an exact typed result plus zero admission/audit/gateway/provider counters and a compatible control.
TC-07 now treats cross-binding independently and requires provider_scope_denied before target lookup and SQLite ledger/effect mutation with exact zero counters.

TC-12 inventories every production application/HTTP DI surface and attempts both role/type resolution and invocation for every test-only trusted signer/mutator, requiring no returned object and zero state/provider change.

TC-10 defines and independently loads a complete immutable matrix for every post-acquisition/repeated-execute outcome_type, lifecycle, HTTP status, key set and variant value domain; every other field is forbidden.
